{{Orphan|date=June 2024}}

In mathematics, a '''period domain''' is a parameter space for a polarized [[Hodge structure]]. They can often be represented as the [[quotient group|quotient]] of a [[Lie group]] by a [[compact group|compact]] [[subgroup]].

* [[Period mapping]]
